summary: SVRN, Inc., the Greek-domiciled former OceanPal Inc., filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt on October 30, 2026 of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications letter finding it failed the terms of a prior exception because its 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F was not filed by October 27, 2026, triggering delisting exposure under Rule 5250(c)(1). The company will request a hearing on or before November 6, 2026, seeking an extended stay; a hearing request stays suspension 15 days absent further Panel relief. A pre-filing OCA consultation on equity-linked instrument classification, including Series C/D Preferred reclassification to temporary equity, remains pending; unfavorable outcome could force restatement. Watch Panel stay grant and OCA timing.
